{
  "name": "@dharmax/ai-cli",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "author": "avi tshuva (dharmax)",
  "description": "Powerful AI-native operating system super shell",
  "type": "module",
  "bin": {
    "ai-cli": "./src/index.ts",
    "aicli": "./src/index.ts"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "start": "bun run src/index.ts",
    "dev": "bun --watch src/index.ts",
    "test": "bun test --concurrency=1",
    "typecheck": "bunx tsc@latest --noEmit",
    "pack": "bun run scripts/pack.ts",
    "install": "bun run pack && bun run src/pack/install-local.ts",
    "test:live:interpretation": "RUN_LIVE_INTERPRETATION=1 bun test tests/interpretation.test.ts"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@dharmax/llm-utils": "file:../llm-utils",
    "@dharmax/semantika": "file:../semantika",
    "@dharmax/shell-proc-utils": "file:../shell-proc-utils",
    "@dharmax/shell-ui": "file:../shell-ui",
    "@dharmax/skill-manager": "file:../skill-manager",
    "@receptron/laya": "^0.1.2",
    "google-auth-library": "^11.1.0",
    "@dharmax/semantic-registry": "file:../semantic-registry",
    "@dharmax/context-manager": "file:../context-manager"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/bun": "latest",
    "@types/node": "latest",
    "typescript": "latest"
  },
  "private": true
}
